slides.title: Connections and payment methods
slides.subtitle: Mercado Pago, dLocal, PayU, 2C2P and PayPlus across LATAM, Southeast Asia and Israel

slides.headline: Four of the five providers you named are live on Yuno today; PayPlus would be a new connection.
rows: Cards (Checkout API), Checkout Pro, Mercado Pago Wallet, Wallet Connect, QR, PIX, Boleto, PSE
Cards, bank transfer and real time payments (PIX, SPEI, PSE, FPX), cash vouchers (OXXO, Boleto, Efecty), wallets (Nequi, Yape, OVO, TrueMoney)
Scoped on request. Israel is covered today through other providers (see Israel slide)
slides.note: adidas integrates once with Yuno: every connection here sits behind the same API and checkout, so you can route, retry and fail over between providers in the same country.
slides.source: Yuno API reference, Payment Type list (docs.y.uno) and Yuno Integrations Directory (y.uno/integrations), Oct 2026
slides.notes: PayPlus does not appear in Yuno's public catalog. Confirm scope and timeline with the integrations team before committing a date.

slides.headline: PayPlus is not yet in Yuno's catalog; Israel is live today through global acquirers and wallets.

items.title: Status
items.body: Not in Yuno's current catalog. Built as a new connection on request.

items.title: What we need
items.body: adidas's PayPlus account setup, the methods you want on it, and expected volume in Israel.

items.title: Same integration
items.body: Once built, PayPlus sits behind the same Yuno API and routing as every other provider. No extra work on the adidas side.

cols.header: LIVE IN ISRAEL THROUGH YUNO TODAY

slides.bar: While PayPlus is scoped, adidas can process in Israel through the live providers and move volume to PayPlus through routing once it is connected.
slides.source: Yuno Payment Type list (docs.y.uno) and Integrations Directory (y.uno/integrations), Oct 2026
slides.notes: Do not commit a PayPlus delivery date. Confirm scope and timeline with Yuno's integrations team first.
